name: cut_without_gap_does_not_inherit
why: ENTRY Z-C21.2, finding L9-2. IFeatureManager~InsertWeldmentTrimFeature2.html, Remarks: «Specify 0 for GapValue to ensure that there is no weld gap. If you exclude swWeldmentTrimExtendOption_WeldGap from the Options parameter, then the weld gap defaults to the last value specified in the SOLIDWORKS user-interface.» Up to library 0.136.0 the bit was turned on only with `gap_mm > 0`: with 0 SOLIDWORKS used the last gap left over, and the summary said `gap_mm: 0`.
defect_caught: One long bar and two short ones in a T, equal, each entering the long one by 40 mm. First the short one (2) is cut WITH a gap of 2 mm, then the short one (3) with `gap_mm: 0`. The second cut must remove exactly the 40 mm of `cut_shortens_the_bar`, 58798.23 mm3, and not the 42 of the gap left over.
_what_it_cannot_show: The gap that the guide calls «last value specified in the SOLIDWORKS user-interface» is set by a hand in the PropertyManager of Trim/Extend, and a case has no hands. Step 4 is the only way the bench has of leaving a non-zero gap in the session, but it is NOT established that an API call updates the value of the interface: if it does not, this case stays green even on the old library. The real scenario (gap given by hand, then `gap_mm: 0`) remains a probe to be done by hand, written in the report of the entry. Step 4 does measure something that no case measured: that the requested gap is applied, 42 mm instead of 40.
_if_it_stays_green_on_the_old_library: It is a REGRESSION case, not the proof of L9-2: if it stays green it means that the API call with the gap at 2 did not leave that gap as the «last value of the interface», and the defect remains unseen. It must be written that way in entry Z-C21.2 of the TODO, with the probe by hand: in SOLIDWORKS, Trim/Extend from the interface with a gap of 2 mm on any two bars, then from the bridge this same step 5 (`gap_mm: 0`) on library 0.136.0 and on the new one, comparing `volume_change_mm3` with -58798.23.
_the_numbers: Section of the 80x80x5 tube: 1469.956 mm2 (from `cut_shortens_the_bar`: 2204933.61 / 1500 mm). Bars: 600 + 300 + 300 = 1200 mm, 1763946.89 mm3. Cut with gap 2: the short one stops 2 mm from the face of the long one, 42 mm removed, 61738.14 mm3. Cut without gap: 40 mm, 58798.23 mm3.

expect.tolerance_why: 1200 mm at 1469.956 mm2: as in `cut_shortens_the_bar`, half a mm3 covers the rounding of the section with the radii; one bar more or fewer shifts hundreds of thousands
42 mm x 1469.956 mm2: the 40 mm inside the long one plus the 2 of gap. The hundredth as in the twin case
40 mm x 1469.956 mm2, as in `cut_shortens_the_bar`. An inherited gap of 2 mm would give -61738.14
expect.why: THE ZERO GAP IS ZERO, not «the one from before»

expect.tolerance_why: 1763946.89 - 61738.14 - 58798.23, read from the part: the second reading of the same fact
